**Current**
- Yahoo lists him as questionable with an undisclosed issue. The newest note says he is healthy and has played in the preseason. (fact, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=1778), stats)
- He is the projected starting center, with Acuff, LaVine, Murray and Ben Simmons. Simmons starts instead of DeAndre Hunter. (fact, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=315), [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=1564), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1510))
- Experts expect his usage to rise and his assists and minutes to return to about 6 assists and 33 minutes. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=433), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=423), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=915), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1584), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1311), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=631))
- Simmons starting next to him makes one expert a bit more cautious, because another ball handler shares the offense. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=262))
- Raynaud and Cardwell are both out at least two weeks. Sabonis and Precious Achiuwa form the center rotation, with possible small ball using Simmons at center. (fact, 2026-10-15, until Raynaud and Cardwell return; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=1706), [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=1564), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=657))
- Experts disagree on the trade risk. Most call a trade the main risk, since on a contender he could become a 23-minute backup. Lloyd thinks a trade is unlikely because of his contract, and another expert thinks he would keep most of his value after a trade. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=471), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1040), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1584), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=915), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=631), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1311), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=423), [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=405))
- Experts value him around round three in category leagues, as roughly a top 25 to 30 player with top 20 upside. One expert thinks taking him in round one is wrong. (verdict, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=366), [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=433), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=442), [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=655), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=739), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1584), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1040), [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1377))
- The Kings play 4, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, so 11 games. They have 14 back-to-backs this season. (fact, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=1824))
- Some drafters pass on him or push him back a few slots because of uncertainty about his role and the Kings' direction. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/hviT4hzYNME?t=567), [10-08](https://youtu.be/WXO8MfQfzo0?t=509), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=739))
- DeRozan, Westbrook and Schroder are gone from Sacramento. They took shots and assists away from him. (fact, 2026-10-08; [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=423), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=407), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=631), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1311), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=915), [09-17](https://youtu.be/DubdKKhMWHo?t=908), [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1254))
- Lloyd says his Yahoo rank of 34 is too low. (verdict, 2026-10-08; [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=423))
- Experts disagree on the Kings' plans. Lloyd expects them to trade or sit veterans and finish near the bottom. Others expect them to try to win to stay out of the relegation zone, so Sabonis plays when available. (verdict, 2026-10-08; [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=407), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1936), [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=392), [10-04](https://youtu.be/n4KkK-OJjqA?t=1291), [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1337))
- In an auction mock, 25 USD was called a reasonable price. He went for 24 USD. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=1356))
- Experts do not expect Maxime Raynaud to cut his minutes or take his starting job. (verdict, 2026-09-21; [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=405), [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=392), [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1436))
- Toronto has talked to the Kings about him before, and Sacramento might try to dump his contract. (fact, 2026-09-14; [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=2562), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=976))
- Mike Miller runs the Kings offense this season. It is unclear whether he will run it through Sabonis. (fact, 2026-07-31; [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=1436), [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=1439))
- Coach Ham calls him the Kings' best player. (fact, 2026-07-31; [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=771))
- His FG% and three-point percentage should bounce back from last season's lows. (verdict, 2026-07-20; [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1408), [07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=596))

**Durable**
- His rebounds and his FG% on high volume are league outliers. His turnovers are high and hurt the TO category. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- He is an elite, unselfish passer and rebounder. He is the best in the league at assists plus rebounds combined, and the numbers pile up when the offense runs through him. (fact, 2026-10-15; [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=1316), [10-05](https://youtu.be/BiIZsSypx7Y?t=1137), [10-15](https://youtu.be/bd8GYKFOe8A?t=655), stats)
- In 2025-26 he pulled his hamstring before the season, then had a rib injury, then a meniscus issue that ended in knee surgery. (fact, 2026-10-15; [10-15](https://youtu.be/PrrgoTEcao4?t=412), [07-31](https://youtu.be/oEywzBZfAvY?t=1277))
- He is a much better points league player than category league player. His game is hard to build around in category leagues when taken early. (verdict, 2026-09-21; [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=375), [08-24](https://youtu.be/g31YlwRe0XQ?t=491), [09-14](https://youtu.be/LM0cRCGoAUQ?t=1311), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=962))
- He needs the ball to rack up assists, many of them from dribble handoffs, so his value depends on a big offensive role. (verdict, 2026-09-14; [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1352), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1040))
- He is not a good three-point shooter and is a poor defender. (fact, 2026-09-14; [07-16](https://youtu.be/-y6p5PYLf00?t=596), [09-14](https://youtu.be/t4n9MAP2_14?t=1040))
- He has never been a steals or blocks player and is a very poor shot blocker. (fact, 2026-07-20; [07-20](https://youtu.be/-KS_AZjZnw4?t=1428), [07-17](https://youtu.be/NYTH7uQsPCM?t=831))

**Tags**
- Current: `questionable` (Yahoo Q (undisclosed); the 10-15 note says he is healthy and played in the preseason), `injury last season` (hamstring, rib, then meniscus surgery; 19 games), `bounce-back` (FG%, assists and minutes expected to recover), `role up` (DeRozan, Westbrook and Schroder gone), `usage competition` (Ben Simmons starts next to him), `trade risk` (Toronto talks; a contender could make him a backup; Lloyd thinks his contract makes a trade unlikely), `expert target` (Lloyd calls Yahoo rank 34 too low), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo average cost 25 USD vs ESPN 37.3 USD), `usage freed` (DeRozan, Westbrook and Schroder gone), `bottom team` (Vegas about 22 wins), `unsettled rotation` (poor coaching and front office make rotations unpredictable), `coach hot seat` (Doug Christie under the most pressure), `tank risk` (Lloyd expects veterans traded or sat; others expect the Kings to play to avoid relegation)
- Durable: `REB specialist` (13.7 rebounds projected), `FG% anchor` (about 58% on 12 to 13 attempts), `high TO` (about 3 turnovers a game), `punt TO fit`, `AST from a big` (best at assists plus rebounds combined), `usage dependent` (needs the ball for handoff assists; could be a 23-minute backup on a contender), `points league player`, `defensive liability`

**Note.** He costs 25 USD on Yahoo and 37.3 USD on ESPN, and went for 41 USD in our league last season. Experts call 25 USD reasonable and see round-three value (rank about 25 to 34), so paying low 30s is fine but 40 USD is not. His elite rebounds, high-volume FG% and big-man assists fit punt TO builds best, but his 3 turnovers and weak FT%, threes and blocks make him hard to build around early. Early in the season, check whether his minutes climb back toward 33 and his assists toward 6 with Simmons starting next to him. Also watch for any trade news and clear up the Yahoo Q tag before the draft.
